_doc: v0.7 art hook. Every layer is optional: null = built-in vector placeholder. Paths are Flutter asset paths (add them to pubspec.yaml). A regions file must keep the ids and properties schema of world_38_lowpoly.geojson (id, name, kind, label_lon, label_lat; Polygon/MultiPolygon; link features optional) or the app falls back to the default map. v0.7: regions + terrain point at the Tactical Holo-Map (art/v0.7/map, MAP_SPEC.md); world_38_lowpoly.geojson stays the fallback and the source of the link features.
